questions.question: Which one is not a product quality factor of McCall quality model ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس عامل جودة منتج في نموذج McCall؟
questions.explanation: McCall's triangular quality framework categorizes its 11 factors into three broad operational categories: - Product Operation: Using the software to perform real-world tasks. - Product Revision: Modifying and debugging the software code. - Product Transition: Porting and adapting the software to new platforms. "Product specification" is an engineering phase, not one of McCall's three quality categories.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** أبعاد ماكول الثلاثة الشهيرة هي: Product Operation وProduct Revision وProduct Transition. لا يوجد بعد باسم «Product specification».

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.14; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: The second level of quality attributes in McCall quality model are termed as
questions.question_ar: المستوى الثاني من سمات الجودة في نموذج McCall يسمى:
questions.explanation: McCall's quality model is structured in a strict hierarchical decomposition: 1. Top Level (High-level Factors): External quality factors representing management and customer viewpoints (e.g., Maintainability, Reliability). 2. Second Level (Quality Criteria): Intermediate software attributes representing software engineering viewpoints that directly affect the factors (e.g., modularity, conciseness, consistency, fault tolerance). 3. Third Level (Quality Metrics): Quantitative direct measurements used to calculate the criteria.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** الهرمية في نموذج ماكول: العوامل (Factors) في القمة ← تليها المعايير الهندسية (Criteria) في المستوى الثاني ← تليها المقاييس الكمية المباشرة (Metrics).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.15; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Which one is not a level in Boehm software quality model ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس مستوى في نموذج Boehm لجودة البرمجيات؟
questions.explanation: Barry Boehm's hierarchical quality model (1978) structures quality across three explicit levels: 1. Primary uses / high-level characteristics: The figure links General Utility directly to Portability and Maintainability. As-is Utility links to Reliability, Efficiency, and Human Engineering; Maintainability links to Testability, Understandability, and Modifiability. 2. Intermediate constructs: Seven constructs, including Portability, Reliability, Efficiency, Human Engineering, Testability, Understandability, and Modifiability. 3. Primitive constructs: The model lists 12 lower-level characteristics. "Final constructs" is not a level in Boehm's taxonomy.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** مستويات نموذج بويم (Boehm) الثلاثة هي: Primary uses ← تليها Intermediate constructs ← ثم Primitive constructs. لا توجد طبقة تسمى «Final constructs».

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.16; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Which one is not a software quality model ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس نموذج جودة برمجيات؟
questions.explanation: McCall's model, Boehm's model, and ISO 9126 are product quality models that evaluate the internal attributes and external runtime characteristics of the software artifact itself. In contrast, ISO 9000 (and ISO 9001) is a Quality Management System (QMS) standard focused strictly on organizational development processes, management commitment, and procedural compliance, rather than evaluating software product attributes directly.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** فرق جوهري: نماذج جودة المنتج البرمجي تشمل McCall وBoehm وISO 9126. أما ISO 9000 فهو معيار إدارة عمليات المنشأة (Process Standard) وليس مقياساً لجودة المنتج البرمجي ذاته.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.17; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Basic execution time model was developed by
questions.explanation: The Basic Execution Time Model was formulated and published by John D. Musa at Bell Laboratories in 1979. It represents one of the foundational Non-Homogeneous Poisson Process (NHPP) software reliability growth models based on execution time.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** نموذج زمن التنفيذ الأساسي (Basic Execution Time Model) وضعه جون موسى (J.D. Musa) في مختبرات بيل عام 1979.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.18; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: NHPP stands for
questions.explanation: NHPP stands for Non-Homogeneous Poisson Process. In software reliability growth modeling, an NHPP is a generalized Poisson stochastic process whose failure rate (intensity function $\lambda(t)$) varies dynamically over execution time rather than remaining constant.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** مصطلح NHPP يعني عملية بواسون غير المتجانسة (Non-Homogeneous Poisson Process)، وتتميز بأن معدل حدوث الأخطاء فيها يتغير مع تقدم زمن الاختبار.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.19; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In basic execution time model, failure intensity is given by
questions.question_ar: في نموذج Basic Execution Time، شدة الفشل تعطى بـ:
questions.explanation: In Musa's Basic Execution Time Model, the failure intensity $\lambda(\mu)$ decreases linearly as a function of the cumulative failures experienced ($\mu$): $$\lambda(\mu) = \lambda_0 \left(1 - \frac{\mu}{v_0}\right)$$ Where: - $\lambda_0$: Initial failure intensity at the beginning of execution ($\mu = 0$). - $v_0$: Total number of failures that would be experienced in infinite execution time. - $\mu$: Cumulative number of failures experienced up to that point.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** دالة شدة الفشل في النموذج الأساسي دالة خطية تنازلية: $\lambda(\mu) = \lambda_0 (1 - \mu/v_0)$. تنخفض الشدة خطياً مع ازدياد الأعطال المكتشفة والمصلحة.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.20; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In basic execution time model, additional number of failures required to achieve a failure intensity objective (Δμ) is expressed as
questions.question_ar: في نموذج Basic Execution Time، عدد حالات الفشل الإضافية المطلوبة لتحقيق هدف شدة فشل Δμ يعبر عنه بـ:
questions.explanation: Rearranging the linear failure intensity relationship for the present intensity ($\lambda_P$) and objective intensity ($\lambda_F$): $$\lambda_P = \lambda_0 \left(1 - \frac{\mu_P}{v_0}\right), \quad \lambda_F = \lambda_0 \left(1 - \frac{\mu_F}{v_0}\right)$$ Subtracting the two equations yields: $$\lambda_P - \lambda_F = \frac{\lambda_0}{v_0} (\mu_F - \mu_P) = \frac{\lambda_0}{v_0} \Delta \mu$$ Solving for $\Delta \mu$ gives: $$\Delta \mu = \frac{v_0}{\lambda_0} (\lambda_P - \lambda_F)$$
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** عدد الأعطال الإضافية اللازمة للوصول إلى هدف الاعتمادية هو: $\Delta \mu = \frac{v_0}{\lambda_0} (\lambda_P - \lambda_F)$. انتبه لطرح الهدف المنخفض من الشدة الحالية $(\lambda_P - \lambda_F)$.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.21; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED on raw source options. Publisher key (A) exactly matches raw option (A). T1 reordered or altered options, but raw source is preserved.

questions.question: In basic execution time model, additional time required to achieve a failure intensity objective (Δτ) is given as
questions.question_ar: في نموذج Basic Execution Time، الزمن الإضافي المطلوب لتحقيق هدف شدة فشل Δτ يعطى بـ:
questions.explanation: In the Basic execution time model, failure intensity decays exponentially with execution time $\tau$: $$\lambda(\tau) = \lambda_0 \exp\left(-\frac{\lambda_0}{v_0} \tau\right)$$ Evaluating between current intensity $\lambda_P$ and target intensity $\lambda_F$: $$\frac{\lambda_P}{\lambda_F} = \exp\left(\frac{\lambda_0}{v_0} \Delta \tau\right)$$ Taking the natural logarithm of both sides and solving for $\Delta \tau$: $$\Delta \tau = \frac{v_0}{\lambda_0} \ln\left(\frac{\lambda_P}{\lambda_F}\right)$$
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** زمن التنفيذ الإضافي المطلوب للوصول لهدف الاختبار: $\Delta \tau = \frac{v_0}{\lambda_0} \ln(\lambda_P / \lambda_F)$. النسبة داخل اللوغاريتم هي القيمة الأكبر على الأصغر $(\lambda_P / \lambda_F)$ لضمان ناتج موجب.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.22; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED on raw source options. Publisher key (D) exactly matches raw option (D). T1 reordered or altered options, but raw source is preserved.

questions.question: Failure intensity function of Logarithmic Poisson execution model is given as
questions.question_ar: دالة شدة الفشل في نموذج Logarithmic Poisson تعطى بـ:
questions.explanation: In the Logarithmic Poisson execution time model (Musa–Okumoto, 1984), failure intensity decreases exponentially with respect to cumulative failures experienced ($\mu$): $$\lambda(\mu) = \lambda_0 \exp(-\theta \mu)$$ Where $\theta$ is the failure intensity decay parameter. This exponential decay captures the realistic observation that early faults contribute much more heavily to failure intensity than subtle faults discovered late in testing.
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** دالة شدة الفشل في نموذج بواسون اللوغاريتمي تنخفض أسياً مع عدد الأخطاء: $\lambda(\mu) = \lambda_0 \exp(-\theta \mu)$.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.23; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED on raw source options. Publisher key (C) exactly matches raw option (C). T1 reordered or altered options, but raw source is preserved.

questions.question: In Logarithmic Poisson execution model, 'θ' is known as
questions.question_ar: في نموذج Logarithmic Poisson، الرمز θ يعرف بأنه:
questions.explanation: In the Logarithmic Poisson formulation, $\theta$ is explicitly termed the failure intensity decay parameter (measured in $\text{failure}^{-1}$). It quantifies the relative reduction in failure intensity per failure experienced: $$\theta = -\frac{d\lambda / d\mu}{\lambda}$$
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** الرمز $\theta$ في نموذج بواسون اللوغاريتمي يمثل معامل تلاشي شدة الفشل (Failure intensity decay parameter).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.24; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In Jelinski-Moranda model, failure intensity is defined as
questions.question_ar: في نموذج Jelinski-Moranda، شدة الفشل تعرف بـ:
questions.explanation: The Jelinski–Moranda model (1972) assumes that software contains an initial total of $N$ faults, each contributing an equal hazard rate $\phi$. When the $i$-th failure occurs, $(i - 1)$ faults have already been completely and perfectly removed without introducing new faults. Thus, during the interval between the $(i-1)$-th and $i$-th failure, the failure intensity is: $$\lambda(t_i) = \phi [N - (i - 1)]$$
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** معادلة جيلينسكي-موراندا: شدة الفشل عند العطل رقم $i$ تتناسب مع عدد الأخطاء المتبقية: $\phi [N - (i - 1)]$.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.25; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: CMM level 1 has
questions.explanation: In the Capability Maturity Model (CMM), Level 1 (Initial) has exactly zero Key Process Areas (KPAs). At Level 1, processes are ad-hoc, chaotic, and undefined; project success depends solely on individual heroism and crisis management rather than repeatable institutional practices. KPAs appear beginning at Level 2 (which has 6 KPAs).
questions.explanation_ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** المستوى الأول في نموذج CMM (المستوى الابتدائي Initial) يحتوي على **صفر من مناطق العمليات الرئيسية (0 KPAs)** لأن العمل فيه فوضوي وغير خاضع لمعايير مؤسسية.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.26; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.
